newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 907 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 907 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 907 contracts compared with 492 overnight Monday, according to the CBOT.
There were 16 wheat, 366 corn, 466 soybean, nine soymeal, 42 soyoil, one rice, two wheat call, two soybean call and three soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was two cents higher to 3/4 lower, corn was steady to 1/2 cent lower and soybeans were 1/4 to one cent lower.
